# A crate: 0.5 m cube, a lid frame (inset top, sunk 0.04). Hull ramp, f7d554 (reads on the pier planks).
new
add mesh cube --name Crate --size 0.5 --location 0 0 0.25
apply
material new Crate --base-color 0.969 0.835 0.329
active Crate
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.07
extrude 0 0 -0.04
mode object
shade flat
export crate.glb
